column1: # After gen.py and normalize.py: python tools/audiogen/raw/gbook_cut.py (press and release apart, the fan as a loop).

column4: The startup sound of a cheap 1990s laptop computer: one single warm soft synthesised major seventh chord, played once on a gentle electric piano pad through a tiny laptop speaker, swelling in and ringing out, slightly detuned and a little melancholy, lo-fi, no melody, no voice, no other sounds
The small plastic power button of an old laptop pressed with one soft clunk, then a faint electric tick of a relay inside the case, close up, quiet small room
The small hard disk of an old laptop spinning up: a thin rising electric whirr that settles, then a few soft dry mechanical ticks of the head, close up, quiet
The hard disk of an old laptop reading: a burst of quiet dry rapid mechanical ticks and chirrs, close up, no hum, no room
A short burst of soft dry ticking from an old laptop hard disk head moving, four or five small mechanical ticks, close up, no hum
One click of the button under an old laptop trackball, a small soft plastic clack, close up, dry, no room
One single key press on a 1990s laptop keyboard, a soft plastic click, close up, dry, no room
The faint steady hum of a small fan and electronics inside an old laptop computer, low, even and thin, close up, continuous, no clicks, no changes
One short soft low electronic alert sound of an old computer through a tiny speaker: a dull hollow wooden clonk made by a synthesiser, one note, lo-fi, dry
A short electronic drop of water alert sound from an old computer through a tiny speaker, one rising pitched plip, lo-fi, dry
A short two note falling electronic error beep from an old computer through a tiny speaker, soft square wave, lo-fi, dry
